roles.participant: Reads the survey pages and answers; every original participant is an AI participant.

scriptedRolesJustification: The paper has no confederates or experimenter roles; the dispatches are pre-written stimuli shown verbatim.
order: dispatches of the condition, one per page, chronological
visibility: Each participant sees only their own condition's pages; no participant sees another's responses (independent respondents).
sampling: n AI participants per arm; the replay uses equal arm sizes instead of YouGov block randomization.
adaptations: Delay tasks (unscramble, word search) are not administered: content not printed (issue i-delay).
Recall questions are not administered: their position is not stated (issue i-recall-pos).
Block randomization on the pre-treatment question is replaced by equal-size arms; the pre-treatment answer is collected and recorded per participant.
Survey and inverse-probability weights are not reproduced; estimates are unweighted (issue i-weights).
No demographic persona is added (issue i-persona).
Response options are shown by label only; the bracketed codes in the appendix are used for scoring (issue i-codes).
